newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends down at intraday low against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends down at intraday low against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed slightly down at an intraday low of 8.2955 from Tuesday's 8.2952 against the U.S. dollar in Shanghai on Wednesday, depressed by speculative selling late in the trading session, dealers said.
The weighted average price on Tuesday was 8.2953.
The yuan opened unchanged at 8.2952 and moved steadily around the 8.2950 level for most of the session, hitting an intraday high of 8.2947. Trading was not active, dealers said.
"Most investors have little interest in trading," said one dealer. "They are not certain about where the yuan will go after Monday's rise."
A second dealer said the yuan was seen meeting heavy resistance at the 8.2950 level.
"The selling that emerged just before the close could be a sign of further losses to come," he said.
Dealers said they expected the yuan to fall slightly on Thursday after failing to stand above 8.2950 on Wednesday.
The yuan continued up to close at 6.7905 from 6.8205 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0718 from 1.0710 against the Hong Kong dollar.
